notes: Community reference: Kocalevent et al. (2013), N=5018; clinical reference groups: Kroenke et al. (2001), N=65 and N=41.
Percentiles are copied from the archived table, without interpolation for patient scores.
Reference quartiles use the first score reaching each percentile; they are discrete intervals, not fitted density curves.
The other-depressive-disorder source column decreases between scores 24 and 25. Its upper-tail values are retained as source evidence and excluded from patient percentile conversion.
Reference comparisons do not establish a diagnosis or matched norms for an individual patient.
